recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, gritty photograph of a young man sleeping horizontally across supermarket bread shelves, paired with large, hand-sketched slab serif typography that dominates the lower third of the frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject body parallel to shelf lines
High-contrast lighting between bright shelves and dark floor
Textural repetition of bread packaging vs. sketchy letter fills
Primary red and yellow accents against neutral grey and white
coreInvariants: Cross-hatched texture within large display type

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject occupies the upper two-thirds, lying horizontally across the middle shelf.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, textured display name in the bottom foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the sleeping face, follow the arm down to the bread slice, then drop to the large text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, empty floor space at the very bottom provides a base for the secondary text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White and grey (hoodie and bread packaging)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the products contrasted with the desaturated, gritty skin tones and floor.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a slightly warm, fluorescent-lit grocery store cast

characterSpecificRedesigns: Circular characters like 'O' contain a central emblem or crest
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A textured, illustrative display face paired with a clean, solid, high-contrast secondary face.
graphicDevices: Parental advisory style warning box in top right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary heavy slab weight for the display text.
Matches the industrial, shelf-label feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A gritty, high-detail photo of a young man in a grey hoodie and red track pants sleeping on a supermarket bread shelf. The shelves are packed with loaves of bread in yellow and white packaging. The lighting is harsh overhead fluorescent. The floor is dark and slightly out of focus.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, hand-sketched slab-serif text in the lower third with a double outline and diagonal cross-hatch fill. Below that, add a single line of distressed yellow stencil text. Place a black and white warning label box in the top right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the subject lying horizontally across shelves?
Is the secondary text yellow and distressed?
Is the lighting gritty and high-contrast?

adjustableVariables: Type of grocery product on shelves
Density of the cross-hatching in the text
mustRedesign: Specific brand names on bread packaging
Exact facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Tactile, hand-drawn quality in the main text
Clear hierarchy between image and typography

postGenerationChecks: Text is legible despite the hatching texture
Subject appears integrated into the shelving unit
Color palette remains grounded in urban/gritty tones
Composition maintains the heavy bottom-weighted feel
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban photography + horizontal subject placement + large-scale sketched slab-serif overlay = Gritty Lifestyle Album Aesthetic
